summary: CEMEX SAB de CV filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, announcing its second quarter 2026 financial results. The press release reports a 24% increase in EBITDA to US$1,018 million, record free cash flow, and raised full-year EBITDA guidance from high single-digit to 16%-17% growth. The filing is a routine earnings update, not a special situation event. No merger, acquisition, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The content is purely operational and financial performance reporting.
